eyebrow: THE FUTURE of hair IS NEURO AFFIRMING
heading: They tipped you well!    But why didn't they come back?
body:
Your salon is not as welcoming as you think it is.                                                       
Our industry likes to think of itself as the welcoming one. For a lot of people it just isn't. They don't complain, they probably tip too much for the inconvenience they feel they caused & THEN they just stop booking. The Unmasked Standard is a for folks that want those clients back. 
Created on a real floor in London Ontario by someone who was tired of watching it happen.
promise: Leave your email and you will hear from us ONCE, when we're live. That's the whole deal.
captureFineprint: Because killer hair shouldn't come with a side of masking
successMessage: WELCOME TO THE NEW UNMASKED SERVICE STANDARD.
